description: CG13494 amino acid composition compared with the D. melanogaster short-protein background
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from collections import Counter
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
A="MDDTLSTVEGGMTETSSWSTTIATTTTTEAAKAGSMAVGIIVLIVVMVLLCCLLIICLPLLCLCGCCGLACSACLACDEGCCGEGGGGGCCGDDGGGCCGDGGGCGDCGDGCGDCTLDDD"
r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/stream",
    params={"query":"(proteome:UP000000803) AND (length:[70 TO 200])","format":"fasta"}, timeout=55)
recs=[]
for blk in r.text.split("\n>"):
    blk=blk.lstrip(">")
    if not blk.strip(): continue
    h,*s=blk.split("\n"); recs.append((h,"".join(s).replace("*","")))
aas=set("ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYV")
recs=[(h,s) for h,s in recs if set(s)<=aas and 70<=len(s)<=200]
print("D. melanogaster proteins 70-200 aa used as background:", len(recs))

bg=Counter("".join(s for h,s in recs)); tot=sum(bg.values()); q=Counter(A)
df=pd.DataFrame([{"aa":a,"CG13494_pct":100*q.get(a,0)/len(A),"Dmel_bg_pct":100*bg[a]/tot} for a in sorted(aas)])
df["fold"]=df.CG13494_pct/df.Dmel_bg_pct
print(df.sort_values("fold",ascending=False).round(2).to_string(index=False))

cys=np.array([100*s.count("C")/len(s) for h,s in recs])
gly=np.array([100*s.count("G")/len(s) for h,s in recs])
thr=np.array([100*s.count("T")/len(s) for h,s in recs])
arom=np.array([100*sum(s.count(x) for x in "FWY")/len(s) for h,s in recs])
basic=np.array([100*sum(s.count(x) for x in "KRH")/len(s) for h,s in recs])
vals={"Cys":(cys,100*A.count("C")/120),"Gly":(gly,100*A.count("G")/120),
      "Thr":(thr,100*A.count("T")/120),"Phe+Trp+Tyr":(arom,100*sum(A.count(x) for x in "FWY")/120),
      "Lys+Arg+His":(basic,100*sum(A.count(x) for x in "KRH")/120)}
for nm,(arr,val) in vals.items():
    print(f"{nm}: CG13494={val:.2f}%  percentile={100*(arr<val).mean():.2f}  n_above={int((arr>=val).sum())}  bg_mean={arr.mean():.2f}%")

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,5,figsize=(16,3.2))
for ax,(nm,(arr,val)) in zip(axes,vals.items()):
    ax.hist(arr,bins=60,color="#9aa6b2")
    ax.axvline(val,color="#c0392b",lw=2)
    ax.set_yscale("log"); ax.set_title(f"{nm}\nCG13494 = {val:.1f}%",fontsize=10)
    ax.set_xlabel("% of residues")
axes[0].set_ylabel("proteins (log)")
fig.suptitle("CG13494 composition against 1,000s of D. melanogaster proteins of 70-200 aa (red line = CG13494)",fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
